about.title: Buellton Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: With just over 5,000 residents along Route 246 and the Avenue of Flags, a death in Buellton is rarely an abstraction; it is a neighbor, a coworker, a parent who drove 2nd Street every morning. Santa Barbara County's public record shows no traffic deaths inside city limits in 2025, and 8 injury collisions that hurt 12 people. Yet wrongful death claims are not only about crashes. They can grow out of a workplace incident, a fall on someone else's property, a defective product, or medical care that went wrong. California treats these as civil matters, entirely separate from any criminal case the District Attorney may or may not bring. The people allowed to file are limited: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial expenses to the financial support the person would have provided and the love, companionship, and guidance the family has lost. LawProactive connects you with an independent attorney at no charge.

whyChoose.title: Why Buellton Families Reach Out Through LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who is allowed to file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you early whether you qualify, so the family is not left guessing.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. A prompt conversation protects your ability to act later.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, and LawProactive itself never charges you anything. You can focus on your family rather than on legal bills during an already heavy season.

items.question: The crash happened on Route 246 near Buellton. Does that change anything about a claim?
items.answer: It might. Route 246 is a state highway, and if a public agency's road design or maintenance played any role, California requires a government claim to be filed on a much shorter timeline than the standard two years. An attorney can sort out who was responsible and which deadlines apply before any of them pass.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. The criminal case is brought by the Santa Barbara County District Attorney and focuses on punishment. A wrongful death action is a separate civil claim brought by the family to recover losses such as funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship and guidance. One can proceed whether or not the other does.

items.question: I was engaged to the person who died. Can I bring the claim?
items.answer: Under California law, standing belongs first to a legal spouse or registered domestic partner and to children. Certain financially dependent people and heirs may also qualify in specific circumstances. Because the rules are narrow and fact-dependent, it is worth having an attorney review your situation rather than assuming you are excluded or included.
